id.description: The unique identifier of the agent whose access control to update.

name.description: Case-sensitive Kibana username of the principal to grant access to.

role.description: Role granted to the principal. Roles are hierarchical: `user` allows viewing, listing, reading, and running the agent; `editor` adds updating the agent and its access control; `manager` adds deleting the agent and managing access control.

entries.description: Access-control entries to apply to the agent. Each entry has a `type` (currently only `user` is supported), a `name` (the principal username), and a `role`.
